notes.title: Demo Patch Update 0.4
notes.content:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fullscreen mode now displays pixels crisply, without blur or smoothing.
[*] Hit rate, critical rate, evasion, magic evasion, and critical evasion now display to the first decimal place on the status screen and in the shop equipment comparison window.
[*] Added an affinity opposition tutorial to the Mishil training grounds.
[*] Desert Nomad Outpost NPCs now have a distinct design consistent with the quest givers.
[*] Added a subplot to the story to enhance the thematic resonance of the main story. The first scene of this subplot has been added to the demo.
[*] Added copyright info to the title screen.
[*] Added a version number to the title screen.
[/list]
[h3]Feedback[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the encounter rate. It will now take roughly 25% more steps to spawn an encounter.
[*] Adjusted early game encounters so that the player will never run into more enemies than the number of characters in the party plus one.
[*] Inscription information now displays on the second line of the help window for the selected magic spell in both the main menu and in battle.
[*] In the battle HUD, the current HP value for a character will now display in yellow text if the character is less than 25% HP, and red text if the character is less than 16.6% HP.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Update 0.2
notes.content:
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] “Ensnare,” “Mind Break,” and “Grass Bomb” now each apply a single rather than a double debuff.
[*] Adjusted enemies’ evasion rate massively down. Most were 5% before the change. Now, early game enemies are in the 0-2% range, with most in the 0-1% range.
[*] Adjusted enemies’ hit rates up. Most early game enemies were around 95% before. Now the average is around 98%.
[*] Adjusted Elia’s hit rate down 2%, but her evasion and critical rates up 1% each.
[*] Adjusted Donovan’s hit rate 4% up.
[*] Reduced Verren’s hit rate 1% up.
[*] Weapons now increase hit rate. Hit rate from weapons increases as the player obtains more advanced weapons.
[*] Footwear armor now increases evasion. Evasion from footwear increases as the player obtains more advanced armor.
[/list]
[h3]Feedback[/h3]
[list]
[*] The bestiary will now remember your last selection within the context of a play session.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a tile passability bug involving tree bases in Benello and the Mishil Capital.
[*] Fixed a broken tree image in Benello.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ability for the “Malformed Subroutine” emblem didn’t work. Gave the emblem a brand new ability.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Update 0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Feedback[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the controls menu to indicate that Q/left trigger is used to open dungeon maps as well as the world map.
[*] Updated the map menu command to also activate and work for dungeons as well as the world map.
[*] Reorganized the Benello map.
[*] Moved the Benello Allea statue up next to Elia’s house.
[*] Added a sparkle effect to all Allea statues.
[*] Added small question marks to the unknown affinity icons in the enemy affinity bar.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a textual issue where a trainer in Mishil said that mastery increases item drop rate (it doesn’t do that anymore).
[*] Fixed a map bug that allowed access to late-game Maklenya Wastes treasure chests in the early game.
[*] Fixed incorrectly passable wall tiles in the Mishil Gorge interval cave.
[*] Fixed a bug whereby the target axlem tier level for Mishil Gorge for the “Hero Worship” quest had diverged from the actual level required to get the quest item.
[*] Fixed a bug where certain turn-zero emblem abilities weren’t occurring during Apollo-initiated battles.
[*] Fixed a bug where talking to General Percy before picking up the Benello Mayor’s quest would cause a crash.
[/list]
